title: Rostocker Urgichten des 16. Jahrhunderts in Fällen von Zauberei und Hexerei. Digitale Methoden und Lehrkonzepte auf der Testbank
institution: Martin-Luther-Universität Halle-Wittenberg (Katrin Moeller and Andreas Müller); source: Stadtarchiv Rostock
author: Katrin Moeller; Andreas Müller (editors)
license_note: Each item carries its own Creative Commons licence (CC BY-SA 3.0 DE for most, CC BY-NC 3.0 DE, CC BY-ND 4.0 for others).
notes: Confessions from magic, sorcery and witchcraft trials before the lower court of the city of Rostock, from the Stadtarchiv Rostock. Each of the 50 items (a person's confession, dated 1543-1596; 20 of them from 1584 and 7 from 1586) is published with the scan (PDF), a TEI-XML transcription and an RTF version; a separate file gives the transcription rules (based on the DTA basic format). The count of items comes from the repository's OAI-PMH listing of the collection; the number of words is not given because the file downloads are protected against automated access (a browser can read them). Deposited in 2019; no later additions were found.
